verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own desktop and features pages say users can 'experience Ubuntu with different choices of default desktop environment, applications and settings, backed by the full Ubuntu archive.' This first-party statement covers both parts of the story: different desktop environments and different default apps. The evidence is a single repeated marketing line, with no named variants and no detailed documentation. missing for 10: a named list of official variants and their desktop environments, documentation on choosing or installing a variant, independent hands-on corroboration of the current variants.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can choose among official variants of the OS with different desktop environments and default apps
